8.2.3 CanXL_HwType
[CP_SWS_CanXL_10027] Definition of datatype CanXL_HwType ⌈
Name
CanXL_HwType
Kind
Structure
XLParams
Type
CanXL_Params*
Comment
Pointer to CAN XL params.
ControllerId

Comment
ControllerId provided by CanIf, identifies the corresponding CAN XL

Hoh
Type
Can_HwHandleType
Elements
Comment
ID of the corresponding CAN XL Hardware Object Range.
Description
This type defines a data structure which provides a CAN XL Hardware Object Handle including its
corresponding CAN Controller and therefore CanDrv as well as the specific CAN XL parameters.

Can_GeneralTypes.h
